REAPER TRACKPAD ENGINE — INTEL INSTALLATION
============================================

This folder contains the Intel x86_64 build. Use it only with an Intel Mac and
the Intel version of REAPER.

1. Fully quit REAPER.
2. Copy reaper_trackpadengine.dylib to:

   ~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/UserPlugins

3. Restart REAPER.
4. Open the Action List and search for "Trackpad Engine".
5. Run "Trackpad Engine: Toggle engine (all gestures)" once.

If the actions do not appear, confirm that the binary architecture matches
REAPER. If macOS quarantined the file, and only if you trust the download, run:

   xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "$HOME/Library/Application Support/REAPER/UserPlugins/reaper_trackpadengine.dylib"

Then fully quit and reopen REAPER.

The SHA-256 checksum is stored in SHA256SUMS.txt.
